text:
olivia: Hey! I'm a new PM starting today — quick q on Notion: where do I find the internal handbook + product docs? Also who do I ask to get edit access to the Product Roadmap pages? Thanks!

devex-bot: Welcome @olivia :tada: Start here: https://redwood.notional/reference/onboarding — the "New Hire Checklist" has links to the handbook and team spaces. For edit access, ping the docs owners or use the /doc-access request form in #devex.

sam: @olivia welcome! Handbook lives in Notion under Redwood > Company > Handbook. Product pages are under Redwood > Product > Roadmap. If you want edit perms for roadmap, DM me the page link and I'll route to owners.

jia: FYI eng docs are separate: Redwood > Eng > Engineering Handbook. For repo-level docs, open a PR in the docs repo. Happy to point you to specific pages.

maria: @olivia added. If you need edit access to the roadmap, fill this short request and paste it here or DM me:

```
Page: /Product/Roadmap/2026-Q2
Reason: Collaborating on feature prioritization + update timelines
Access level: Editor
SRE or infra approvals: N/A
```

maria: Once I approve I will add you; expect ~30 min during working hours.

alex: Also heads-up: we have templates in Redwood > Templates > Product — use the "Roadmap Update" template for safe edits. If you want a template copied to a personal workspace, say so.

olivia: Awesome thank you all! I'll paste the request in a bit. One more quick thing — do we have a template for "user-impact notes" that non-engineers can leave on feature pages?

sam: yep — Product > Templates > User Impact Notes. Short format: Problem, Who it helps, Metrics to track. If you can't find it, ping me and I'll share.

olivia: Found it, thanks! :coffee:
